Lrayox <lra...@aol.com> wrote:
>The Trap card reads...
>Does the second sentence mean that a) you can play other cards until you
>chose not to, then three rounds must pass without Methuselahs playing cards
>or b)three rounds must be played without additional cards being played?

It means that during the combat in which Trap was used, each round has an
automatic press to continue if any card (including Trap) has been played
within the last three rounds.
